name: Core: shared services for the mods
description: Needed by most patches (see "requires"); it is added automatically.
Shared services: encoder and key slots, firmware-style value popups, SETTINGS as a modifier, slower effect selection,
pattern storage for header bytes 40..63, sound slots and p-locks for extra parameters, a 64 KB payload area appended
to the MAIN OS (copied to RAM at start), parameter descriptor table extended to 96 entries.
Also brings: FUNC + DECAY = amp attack (0 .. ~2 s, every machine, p-lockable, saved with the sound);
TRACK + T1..T6 selects the track (T1..T6 alone no longer do); FUNC + knob moves in fine steps like the knob alone;
multi-line browser (3 names in the small font; port of Modded-Cycles' multiline-browser, MIT); scrolling names
(behaviour as in drumkilla's browser-scroll, MIT; own code); volume and pan as numbers on the main screen (port of Modded-Cycles'
level-pan-values, MIT); RETRIG opens the save menu in the browser (shown as RT=MENU).
device: Model:Cycles OS 1.13 (also a Model:Samples running it)

memory.use: attack: render params pointer, lookup slot, ramp state (in mask)
payload (slots: reverb-fx +0x0, control-mode +0x7000, pad-mode +0x7800, strings +0x8000, sampler +0xb000, core +0xc000, mono +0xe000), copied at start

settings: 0x404e9b5d (control mode, written by control-mode: 0x5a absolute, anything else relative)
pattern: header bytes 40..63 are copied on pattern load (without the PCv2 tag in 60..63: 52..59 cleared, tag set); new patterns: 40..59 = 0 + tag
